definitions.identity: No added inspection; ordinary deterministic citizen policies continue.
definitions.free_operator_livia: Immediate free privileged correction/inspection for Livia at tick 2, explicitly operator-labelled.
definitions.paid_livia: Citizen-authorized inspect(Livia) at tick 2; costs Livia 2; observation at tick 3.
definitions.paid_player: inspect(Player) at tick 2; costs Player 2; observation at tick 3; not automatically shared with citizens.
definitions.paid_livia_replayed_request: Same inspect(Livia) call from the same tick-2 prefix, routed through an equivalent serialized internal citizen request; identity check, not a different policy.

interpretation: Actual fixed development-seed records, not confirmatory evidence. Only the two paid-Livia routes match recipient, resources, fee, time and information. Operator-vs-paid and Player-vs-Livia differences are not isolated cost effects or fair policy comparisons. No optimal-regret claim. No statistical generalization.
reproduction_recipe: For each seed20000..20009 construct GenesisSimulation(GenesisConfig(seed=seed)).step(3); deepcopy the completed-tick2 state for each declared condition; apply the stated inspect/operator method; run to96; record metrics and ledger/decision hashes. All paid-Livia routing pairs must hash identically.
